To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Melissa officinalis based product might be safe and effective in decreasing the serum triglyceride level in dyslipidaemic diabetic patients.

the effects of Melissa officinalis on the lipid profile and systolic and diostolic blood pressure in diabetic patients are not significant, however, in patients with higher serum levels of triglyceride, systolic and diastic blood pressure, Melissa officinalis might have a positive effect.

the use of a Melissa officinals-based product for three months, in patients with type-2 diabetes mellitus and dyslipidemia, resulted in significant reduction of triglyceride levels, in patients with higher initial triglyceride levels (TG≥200mg/dL), as well as significant decrease in systolic and diastic blood pressure in patients with higher SBP≥130 and DBP≥85mmHg, respectively, compared to baseline values.
